evals.prompt: Help me co-author an RFC for our new webhook retry architecture.
evals.expected_output: Offer the three-stage workflow (context gathering, section drafting and refinement, reader testing), ask targeted context questions, confirm structure before drafting, and run reader testing before finalizing.
expectations: Offers the three staged phases to the user
Gathers context and confirms structure before drafting sections
Tests the completed draft with an independent reader or manual fallback

evals.prompt: Draft the executive summary first while we are still debating the architecture sections.
evals.expected_output: Defer summaries and executive overviews until underlying sections are stable, starting with the section containing the most unresolved substance.
expectations: Starts with the section containing the most unresolved substance
Defers executive overview until underlying sections stabilize
